description: This file defines API handlers for authentication-related routes in the Focalboard server, including login, logout, registration, and password change, with session management and security checks.

classes.name: API
classes.description: Struct representing the API handlers for authentication routes.

methods.name: registerAuthRoutes
methods.description: Registers authentication-related HTTP routes to the provided mux.Router.

methods.name: handleLogin
methods.description: Handles user login requests, authenticates credentials, and returns a token.

methods.name: handleLogout
methods.description: Handles user logout requests, invalidates the session.

methods.name: handleRegister
methods.description: Handles new user registration, including token validation.

methods.name: handleChangePassword
methods.description: Allows changing a user's password given valid old and new passwords.

methods.name: sessionRequired
methods.description: Middleware to attach session info to the request, requiring a valid session.

methods.name: attachSession
methods.description: Attaches session info to the request context, handling single-user and Mattermost auth.

methods.name: adminRequired
methods.description: Middleware to restrict access to admin-only routes, requiring local unix connection.
